name: 海洋（基础版）
english_description: A wuxia MUD set in the world of Jin Yong's novels (new characters are asked not to reuse the novels' own character names), whose community calls itself the Qingyimeng, the "Covenant of Passion and Righteousness." Despite sharing the "Ocean" name with this project's hy2000/hy2002/hy5, a live comparison found no lineage relationship -- master file hashes and securd.lpc/feature/skill.lpc don't match any of them, so its bugs (of the same general classes) were independently confirmed rather than inherited. Characters roll four attributes -- strength, comprehension, physique, and agility -- and can randomize any or all of them at creation. Deep functional testing walked the full path from registration through the newbie sequence (inn, West Main Street, Yangzhou martial hall), a Central Square brawl, death, the five-part Ghost-Gate dialogue with the White-Robed Ghost, and revival at the martial temple, plus confirmed the bulletin-board post/look chain works end to end. Night genuinely darkens the map -- bare direction words like "north" stop working after dark with a "too dark to see" message, forcing "go <direction>" instead -- an intentional day/night mechanic, not a bug. Fixes included a euid daemon whose own registration-time file permissions kept resetting to empty, two missing-file sscanf() crashes that could halt registration on a fresh checkout, and a reentrant ACL crash triggered by the security daemon reading its own not-yet-initialized state. See NOTES.md.
